content: Lexical Matching. The lexical matching score is used to calculate the matching coverage of the ancient clause INLINEFORM0 . It contains two parts: exact matching and dictionary matching. An ancient Chinese character usually corresponds to one or more modern Chinese words. In the first part, we carry out Chinese Word segmentation to the modern Chinese clause INLINEFORM1 . Then we match the ancient characters and modern words in the order from left to right. In further matching, the words that have been matched will be deleted from the original clauses.
